title: The Angel in Joseph's Dream
reflectionText: He had already resolved to be merciful — to let her go quietly rather than expose her. Then the angel asked something harder than mercy: to stay, to name the child, and not to be afraid. What does it ask of you, when God's will arrives not as the answer you were looking for, but as a harder thing you are simply told to do?
